demo.realm.title: Realm
demo.realm.body: Your realm is made of [[demo.province|provinces]]. Its [[demo.stability|stability]] decides how calm it stays, your [[demo.prestige|prestige]] how much you are feared.

demo.province.title: Province
demo.province.short: A stretch of land with people in it.
demo.province.body: A province pays [[demo.taxes|taxes]] and provides soldiers. When its people are unhappy, [[demo.unrest|unrest]] grows there.

demo.stability.title: Stability
demo.stability.short: How settled your realm is (−3 to +3).
demo.stability.body:
High stability lowers [[demo.unrest|unrest]] in every [[demo.province|province]]. High [[demo.taxes|taxes]] and lost wars reduce it; [[demo.prestige|prestige]] raises it again.

Currently: **{stability}**

demo.unrest.title: Unrest
demo.unrest.body: Once a [[demo.province|province's]] unrest rises above 5, a [[demo.revolt|revolt]] looms. High [[demo.stability|stability]] lowers it, high [[demo.taxes|taxes]] drive it up.

demo.revolt.title: Revolt
demo.revolt.body: Rebels seize a [[demo.province|province]] and lower the [[demo.stability|stability]] of the whole realm – a vicious circle. Only content [[demo.nobles|nobles]] or lower [[demo.taxes|taxes]] break it.

demo.taxes.title: Taxes
demo.taxes.body:
Taxes bring in [[demo.gold|gold]] but raise [[demo.unrest|unrest]].

*Rule of thumb:* never high taxes and low [[demo.stability|stability]] at the same time.

demo.nobles.title: Nobles
demo.nobles.short: The powerful families of your realm.
demo.nobles.body: Content nobles support [[demo.stability|stability]]. Angry nobles demand privileges and chip away at your [[demo.prestige|prestige]].
